verdict.rationale: While GoDaddy documents self-serve PAT credential generation (godaddy-docs-9, godaddy-docs-25, godaddy-docs-31), there is no evidence of any sandbox or test environment for domains — instead the docs explicitly state that registration charges the real billing method and is not reversible (godaddy-docs-2), directly contradicting the 'test safely without cost' part of the story.
